jobs.description: A new country. A modern dental practice. And the opportunity to become an important part of a team that is building for the future.At Steenwijkerdiep, you will work as a General Dentist in a professional and well-equipped group practice in Steenwijk. You will be surrounded by experienced colleagues, have access to modern equipment and high-quality materials, and receive support with the practical steps involved in starting your career in the Netherlands.Your roleAs a General Dentist at Steenwijkerdiep, you will provide a broad range of general dental care to your patients.You will work in a professional environment where patient-centred care, quality and teamwork are central. You will have the freedom and resources to focus on good dentistry, while being supported by an experienced team around you.This position also offers the opportunity to become an important part of the future of the practice. There is room for you to take on a key role within the team and grow with the practice over time.About SteenwijkerdiepSteenwijkerdiep is a modern dental practice located in Steenwijk, the Netherlands.Our group practice offers a broad scope of dental care and consists of a multidisciplinary team of dentists, dental hygienists and dental assistants. By combining professional expertise with advanced equipment and high-quality materials, we aim to provide our patients with the highest possible standard of care.The atmosphere within the practice is professional, collaborative and patient-focused.What we are looking forFor this position, you have:•    Completed a relevant study in the sector Health-technical professions at WO/Master’s degree level;•    A minimum B1 level of English and the willingness to learn the Dutch language;•    A minimum of 3 months’ work experience as a dentist;•    A category B driving licence.What we offerYou can expect:•    A salary between €3,300 and €5,500 gross per month, depending on qualifications and experience;•    An annual contract for 32–40 hours per week, with the intention of offering a permanent contract;•    Variable working hours;•    Excellent secondary employment conditions;•    A modern and professional workplace;•    Support with finding accommodation;•    Support and information regarding the recognition of your foreign diploma and your possibilities to work during that period.A practical start in the NetherlandsMoving abroad for work involves more than simply finding the right job. Having a place to live from the start makes that transition considerably easier. Accommodation is available at two residential parks, both located approximately 4–5 kilometres by bicycle from the practice. The homes can be rented for a minimum period of three months, subject to availability, with several accommodation options available for different situations.This gives you the possibility to arrange accommodation close to your workplace when you first arrive in the Netherlands, giving you time to settle into your new job and surroundings without having to immediately search for housing on your own.Interested in joining Steenwijkerdiep?We are looking for a General Dentist who values high-quality care, enjoys working as part of a professional team and would like to build a long-term career in the Netherlands.For more information about the position, the recognition process for your foreign diploma, the possibilities to work during this period or the application process, please contact: iris.vermeer@uwv.nl
